description: I built this Donkey Kong remake as part of my project I completed for my A-level's in Computer Science. We were tasked with developing and documenting a 2D video-game in Python using a 2D-graphics known as Pygame. For my project I decided to build a remake of Donkey Kong as I was interested in 8-bit video games at the time and thought it would be an achievable goal. The project spanned over the course of 2 years where I had to plan, design, develop, test and evaluate my project.
features: Music and Sounds that can be adjusted
Leaderboard system that uses SQL for retrieving local results
reflection: Over the course of my project timeline, I tacked with hundreds and nearly thousands of lines of code manually. It felt nearly impossible to finish halfway through.
